onset.Description: Event onset in seconds relative to the beginning of the EEG recording.

duration.Description: Event duration in seconds. Zero indicates an instantaneous event marker.

sample.Description: Event sample index in the EEG recording, rounded from EEGLAB event latency.

trial_type.Description: BIDS-compatible event label derived from the original EEG event value.

is_tms_pulse.Description: Indicates whether the event corresponds to a TMS pulse.

event_id.Description: Unique event identifier used to link rows in events.tsv with the corresponding rows in the stimulation metadata file.

TMSTriggerLabelsUsed.Description: Original event labels used to identify TMS pulse events.
